scope: Source/cropped render review, not Core limb physics/contact or Native acceptance

hurt.observed: Head/shoulder recoil -> brief lowered compression -> settling support -> stable stance. A balancing paw can lift; this is not evidence that all4paws contact ground in every frame.
hurt.anatomy: Visible near fore/hind paws and body links remain bear-like. Rear first phase shows a hind sole; far limbs can be hidden.
hurt.direction: Body retains row facing, front head flinches slightly sideways; rear shows no face.

fall.observed: Fore elbow/knee support buckles, chest/head and hindquarters descend, then the intact body rests low on belly/slight flank.
fall.anatomy: Forelegs fold/extend forward and hind knees fold/splay; the fully low body occludes far leg paths. No rigid standing final body.
fall.direction: Four headings retained; rear collapse remains rear with tiny tail/back of head only.

sleep.observed: Closed eyes where face is visible, head rests on layered forepaws, low flank/abdomen bears weight; subtle chest/head/paw resettling across4unique source poses.
sleep.anatomy: Side views show relaxed overlapping limbs and a visible hind pad; front/rear foreshorten the resting flank. The full torso roll angle and hidden paw contacts are not independently proven.
sleep.direction: Low head remains generally row-facing, front tilts in rest; rear never exposes an eye/muzzle.

rise.observed: Low awake effort with planting forepaws -> forelimb chest push while hips remain low -> hindquarters rise -> four-legged stance. Independent new generation, not reversed fall.
rise.anatomy: Visible paws push below the bear shoulders/hips; far folded limbs under low body are partly occluded. No bipedal jump or helping object.
rise.direction: Row facing and short muzzle maintained; rear rises without a visible front face.

work.observed: Stationary lowered head -> lower sniff -> small jaw/cheek chew -> partial head/swallow recovery. No baked food/prey or combat lunge.
work.anatomy: Four-leg body with visible planted near paws, far legs partly hidden by body. Neck/jaw provide motion; no walking stride or extra limb.
work.direction: Front/left/right short muzzle axes retained, rear head lowers out of sight beyond shoulders.

sharedModel: Broad heavy shoulders/ash-grey mane, warm brown short broad muzzle, small round ears, tiny tail and thick quadruped bear paws. New source end heights/body proportions only approximately match the old family.
